description: Figure 2 is a line plot with the x-axis labeled "Cost" and the y-axis labeled "Reliability Score". The x-axis ranges from 0 to 10, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis ranges from 30 to 90, with tick labels at intervals of 10. There are three lines in the plot, each representing a different model. The blue line represents the 3-Model Ensemble, the red line represents the 2-Model Ensemble, and the yellow line represents GPT-4. The 3-Model Ensemble line starts at a reliability score of 90 and decreases steadily to a score of 70 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble line starts at a reliability score of 90 and decreases more gradually to a score of 70 at a cost of 8. The GPT-4 line starts at a reliability score of 90 and decreases more gradually to a score of 70 at a cost of 6.
